name: Class Critique
description: Whole-class critique on a presentation, idea, or pitch. The presenter shares verbally; the class rates on three custom scales.

intro.message:
Class Critique

The presenter shares their idea now — give them your full attention. When they finish, you'll rate it on three scales. Be honest and constructive.

rate-it.prompt: Rate the presentation on each scale below.

phase-4.message:
Talk it out

Where did we disagree the most? Presenter — which score surprised you, and what's one thing you'd change based on the charts?

recommendedFor: Use after presentations, pitches, or shared work. Customize the three scales to fit the lesson.
